analysis_semantics.partial_order: weakly_nonworse_on_both_full_observed_CTP_curves, with at least one strict threshold across either curve
analysis_semantics.dense_nonconvergence: any nonconverged eligible path in grid or incumbent makes both formal nondominated sets not determined and forbids a winner

control_variable_analysis.definition: one control changes inside each exactly matched context; summaries do not define a scalar or post-hoc winner

exact_vs_inexact.causal_label: descriptive confounded family-package comparison; exact/no-reparam/operationally-unbounded versus inexact/reparam/c50 are jointly changed, so no effect is causally attributed to reparameterization
exact_vs_inexact.c50_binding_requirement: report frozen cap-binding evidence; unavailable evidence forbids a claim that c50 approximates operationally unbounded
